actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: DroneReachPos-v0 is registered with vector_entry_point=ReachPosEnv
DroneEnv is a gymnasium.vector.VectorEnv and declares autoreset_mode NEXT_STEP
The number of worlds defaults to 1
The action space is batched over the number of worlds
The fitted so_rpy command interface is [roll_rad, pitch_rad, yaw_rad, thrust_N]
With attitude control the action space is a Box whose roll, pitch and yaw bounds are +-pi/2 and whose collective thrust bounds are 4*thrust_min and 4*thrust_max
The default drone of DroneEnv is cf2x_L250
For cf2x_L250 the per-motor thrust bounds are 0.012817578393224994 N and 0.12 N
The cf2x_L250 mass is 0.0328 kg, acc_coef is 0.0 and cmd_f_coef is 1.023224599403443
The gravity vector is [0, 0, -9.81] m/s^2
The observation space is a Dict of pos (3), quat (4), vel (3) and ang_vel (3), batched by world
ReachPosEnv adds difference_to_goal (3) to the observation Dict
DroneEnv.reset(seed) seeds the simulation, resets it and returns the observation and an empty info
ReachPosEnv samples the goal before resetting the simulation; the options goal_pos_min and goal_pos_max override the goal bounds
The default goal box is [-1, -1, 0.5] to [1, 1, 1.5]
The reset position box defaults to [-1, -1, 1] to [1, 1, 2] and the velocity box to -1 to 1 m/s
The reset randomization draws positions and velocities uniformly from those boxes
DroneEnv.step applies the action, advances the simulation by n_substeps, resets the worlds marked done and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and an empty info
The episode terminates when the drone z position is below zero
The episode truncates when the simulation time reaches max_episode_time
max_episode_time defaults to 10.0 s
The ReachPos reward is exp(-2 * distance) and -1 when the episode terminated
The environment frequency defaults to 500 Hz
The simulation frequency defaults to 500 Hz
n_substeps is sim.freq // freq
The MuJoCo timestep is 1 / freq
The attitude action is clipped to the action space bounds before it is applied
The default simulation state has an identity quaternion [0, 0, 0, 1] and zero position, velocity and angular velocity
seed sets the JAX rng key of the simulation

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial position, velocity and goal of one world, and the fake dynamics are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; this package's fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream draws with JAX's generator, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: one world of a batched vector environment: the upstream spaces carry a leading world dimension and the fake keeps that dimension but contains one world and one drone
the fake follows the commanded roll, pitch and yaw directly and leaves angular velocity at zero; the fitted second-order rotational dynamics, rotor dynamics and collisions are not modelled
the translational part is the ideal so_rpy thrust/gravity model with the cf2x_L250 parameters, but the fake was never compared with a JAX/MuJoCo run and no physical device is modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (2 ms) only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the sim backend (gymnasium.make on the vector_entry_point) was not run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
